routes.name: R167_PV_AUDIT
routes.description: Verify all locus cases over K_0, then the actual radical field and both rank branches. This is a dependency audit, not completion of the campaign.

routes.name: R167_PV_SMALL_FIELD
routes.description: Independence in a smaller function field cannot establish independence after enlarging its coefficient field.

C9000167.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 167 (Planar distinct distances and unit-distance bounds.; papers: The weak pinned planar distance theorem; A power saving for planar unit distances; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/167.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C167_PV_AUDIT.statement: Under the exact manuscript setup, alg:private-valuations and its unused-sign-change consequence hold over the actual enlarged field; upstream extraction and both main theorems remain unverified.

C167_PV_VAL.statement: All stated locus cases supply private valuations on K_0(V_1), hence independent square classes there.

C167_PV_PLANE.statement: The left-plane case has private order at the linear prime in K_0(z)[w].

C167_PV_SHEET.statement: Different loci or a same-curve projection of degree at least two have private simple alternate-sheet points and formal local valuations over K_0.

C167_PV_LINE.statement: Identical line loci have private simple zeros of L_l-4.

C167_PV_FRACTIONAL.statement: Identical fractional-linear loci with b nonzero and b different from one have private simple zeros of L_l-4.

C167_PV_KUMMER.statement: Independent square classes in the final field give the full monomial basis and all sign automorphisms of its actual radical extension.

C167_PV_CORE.statement: Finite private-order parity, single-radical independence, and unused-sign linear algebra, with geometric and automorphism-existence hypotheses explicit.

C167_PV_SIGN.statement: The rank-two and common-line branches of the actual j=5 radical linear system contradict all nonzero A-A'_l.
